history.summary: Baseline, taken at the state following the UI-registry work: Deck defaults to count-only so draw piles report their size again, AutoUI and Die3D moved off the boardsmith/ui barrel, and the board-side ValidElement became BoardTarget. Also introduces the contract itself — ENGINE_CONTRACT and ENGINE_REVISION are exported from the boardsmith root so the platform can read the vendored engine's revision at runtime.

Contract fingerprints widened after an adversarial review found them narrower than claimed: surfaceHash now includes prototype members (games call methods, and renaming one used to move neither hash), and the payload fixture now boots through GameRunner with a simultaneous opening step so flow state, isMyTurn and availableActions are covered — the blank-action-bar layer, previously invisible.

Checkpoint retention: games can bound per-action undo checkpoints with checkpoints:{max|enabled}; snapshot.actionCheckpoints is now a {baseIndex,entries} window, and a pruned undo target is refused with a message naming the policy
